COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No.23 of 2014
Hon 'b le Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.
None for petitioner.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Senior Advocate,
assisted by Mr. Mukesh Kapurwan, Advocate,
for the respondent No.3.
Mr. Ajay Veer Pundir, Advocate, for the
respondent/University.
This writ petition was decided finally by
the coordinate Bench of this Court vide its
judgment dated 10.05.2015. Seeking a review
of this judgment, learned counsel for the
respondent had filed the review petition. The
review petition too was dismissed for want of
prosecution by an order dated 12.10.2017.
Seeking its recall, an application for recall was
filed on 27.08.2019, with the delay condonation
application, praying condonation of 584 days.
Learned coordinate Bench of this Court
while taking cognizance to the Restoration
Application (MCC No.550 of 2019), as well as
the Delay Condonation Application (CLMA
No.8333 of 2019) by an order dated
21.06.2019, had directed the review applicant
to take steps for effecting services on the
petitioner within one week. Ever since then, the

matter has not been listed, and there is an office
report dated 07.09.2020, that the review
applicant has not taken any steps for effecting
the services on the petitioner.
Today, when the recall application was
taken up, the learned Senior Counsel for the
respondent had sought time to take steps for
effecting the services on the petitioner. But on
perusal of the order-sheet, this Court is not
inclined to grant time to the respondent/review
applicant to take steps in compliance to the
order passed way back on 21.06.2019, except
after imposition of the cost of Rs.50,000/-,
which is to be deposited in the High Court Bar
Association Advocate Welfare Fund. Until and
unless, the respondent places on record, the
proof of deposit of cost of Rs.50,000/- by the
respondent, he would not be permitted to take
steps to serve the petitioner, on the recall
application.

( Sh ar ad Ku m ar Sh ar m a, J.)
 26.10.2021
NR/
